chapter.title: Divine Hands
chapter.subtitle: Passage costs proof. The storm collects interest.
chapter.description: Anunaki Arrival · Chapter 5. Passage costs proof. The storm collects interest.

tips: Complete the chapter to advance. Optional stars never block the next chapter.

scenes.speaker: Inanna
scenes.text: Visitors from nowhere, carrying stolen equipment and a walking laboratory incident. You need an introduction.

scenes.speaker: Inanna
scenes.text: I meant an introduction in the arena.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: A fair contest for safe passage. State the rules.

tips: Borrow Inanna. A Tablet makes her reveal stronger; without one she still gains +1 Hand.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: Borrow Inanna. A Tablet makes her reveal stronger; without one she still gains +1 Hand.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Inanna
preDialogue.text: No speeches after the bell. Show me what those hands learned.

preDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
preDialogue.text: My hands learned the purchase agreement was verbal.

postDialogue.speaker: Inanna
postDialogue.text: You can fight. You can also stop when the contest is won. I respect that.

postDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
postDialogue.text: Then we leave the arena as guests.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Ninhursag makes a Tablet and supports an ally. Consume it later to trigger her growth and cleanse.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: Ninhursag makes a Tablet and supports an ally. Consume it later to trigger her growth and cleanse.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Inanna
preDialogue.text: One round tells me your strength. The next tells me your patience.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: Both are useful on a road this long.

postDialogue.speaker: Inanna
postDialogue.text: Take the passage seal. Enlil may pretend he cannot read it.

postDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
postDialogue.text: So we are doing weather next.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Complete the chapter to advance. Optional stars never block the next chapter.

scenes.speaker: Nabu
scenes.text: The record is complete. Read each clue before moving the pieces. A correct sequence is safer than a quick guess.

puzzle.title: Ground the Storm
puzzle.instruction: Connect the safety sequence. Empty the conductor before opening the ground route. Open ground before reconnecting the gate. Test the gate last.

pieces.label: Reconnect gate
pieces.detail: Only after the ground path exists.

pieces.label: Open ground
pieces.detail: Give the surge a safe path.

hints: Drain the charge before touching the gate.
puzzle.solvedText: The surge goes into the empty ground channel. The route opens, but the damaged core cannot survive another jump.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew works through the clues with you. You continue with the same story progress and rewards.

tips: The middle district closes in round 3 for both sides. Establish an outside route first.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: The middle district closes in round 3 for both sides. Establish an outside route first.

preDialogue.speaker: Enlil
preDialogue.text: That machine pulls against the descent field. Every moment it remains here, the sky strains.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: Then help us repair it instead of trapping it here.

postDialogue.speaker: Enlil
postDialogue.text: The center corridor must close while I ground the surge.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Enlil consumes a Tablet to double his weakening. Time it against the enemy’s committed district.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: Enlil consumes a Tablet to double his weakening. Time it against the enemy’s committed district.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Enlil
preDialogue.text: Hold the boundary until the storm passes. I will judge the machine after.

preDialogue.speaker: Inanna
preDialogue.text: And judge their work while you are looking.

postDialogue.speaker: Enlil
postDialogue.text: Boundary secure. The machine’s core is still fractured.

postDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
postDialogue.text: Ninhursag can restore it. Show us the way.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: We beat the arena and the weather. Can we please get a repair receipt?

scenes.speaker: Inanna
scenes.text: You earned passage. Keep the seal.

scenes.speaker: Enlil
scenes.text: Take it below, to Ereshkigal’s gate. Ninhursag will meet you there.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Below. Of course the way home goes further away first.
